description: Shared agentbox.guest v1 frames. direction is the sender. frame is the frame text, or a list of parts where {repeat, count} stands for repeat concatenated count times; frame_hex gives raw bytes. canonical is the expected encoding when it differs from frame.

host exec 8 items of 4096 bytes is exactly the total limit
host exec multibyte item of exactly 4096 bytes
host exec env and stdin in canonical order
host stdin of exactly 2048 bytes at the largest sequence
